verdict.rationale: Sierra shows it can run standalone across channels (chat, phone, email, SMS, messaging) and connects to backend systems. The evidence includes generic 'systems integrations', an MCP gateway to company tools, point-and-click wiring to internal APIs, and Live Assist that captures and updates customer context. None of it names Zendesk, Salesforce or Intercom, and none describes the agent running inside a helpdesk or syncing tickets both ways. Missing for 10: documented native Zendesk/Salesforce/Intercom integrations, an embedded in-helpdesk deployment mode, bidirectional ticket and context sync, and independent corroboration.
